description: Display of an internally illuminated fascia sign; display of an internally illuminated roundel sign, suspended internally behind glazing at first floor level; and display of an internally illuminated double-sided projecting sign.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The period of this consent shall expire 5 years from the date of this notice.

Condition required to be imposed by the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) Regulations 2007.

Condition : 3 - The advertisements hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Fascia sign: Acrylic face, stainless steel lettering

- Internal roundel: Acrylic

- Projecting sign: Acrylic face and steel frame

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.  

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1 and DC9 of the Local Plan (2018).


Notes:
Look out for different brick colour/if they are proposing different mortar bonding/different material entirely.  The text in red is just a guide for commonly used materials so you need to edit to reflect what is being approved.

If very specific window details are needed may need to be a separate condition.

If different materials for different windows/elevations specify the floor/elevation to which these details relate.

Condition : 4 - Level of illumination

The illumination of the sign(s)/advertisement(s) shall comply with the recommendations of the Institution of Lighting Professionals in the 'Guidance Note 01/20: Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Obtrusive Light' and the 'Professional Lighting Guide No 5, 2023 - Brightness of Illuminated Advertisements'.

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not adversely affected by artificial lighting, in accordance with Policies CC12 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 5 - Non-intermittent

Any illumination of the advertisements hereby approved shall not be intermittent and there shall be no changing light patterns.

Intermittent illumination would be unacceptable in the interests of public safety as it is likely to distract the attention of drivers of vehicles, in accordance with Policy T1 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principle TR28 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).

Condition : 6 - Illumination during opening hours

The advertisements hereby granted consent shall only be illuminated during the opening hours of the business to which the advertisements relates.

In the interests of visual amenity, residential amenity, and highway safety, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC8, DC9, CC12 and T1 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principles of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
